newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in Kansas on Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Inquiry good, demand moderate, USDA said.

Sales confirmed on 25,400 slaughter steers and 18,800 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 60,000 head confirmed, including 16,800 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1325 lbs 65.00, about 400 head 65.50, pen 64.50; few Select with end Choice 64.00-64.50.
Dressed Basis Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 106.00-107.50 hot weights, delivered.

Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 65.00, few 64.50; few Select with end Choice 64.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1030-1225 lb heifers and heiferettes 63.00-65.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1200 lb heiferettes 60.00.
Dressed Basis Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 107.00-107.50, hot weights, delivered.
